note: The source of the chain's block in office/components.css (python tools/build_things.py). The lamp's chain (Orkboard's decisions §271.1, §271.4): bronze links hung from the window's top edge and a bead to pull, 6 x 29 cells, 2 px a cell (12 x 58). A state is `rows`, a letter a cell, `.` nothing; `H` the bronze's light, `B` the bronze, `L` its shade. At rest 18 rows of links (three of a six-row period: an edge-on link through a ring) and the bead (7 rows) under them; pulled, four rows longer, the bead lower. The box is as tall as the pulled chain, so a pull moves nothing but the bead.
